description: Online newcomer adaptation with frozen resident populations
research_question: Does a newcomer acquire a resident symbol protocol online, and does topology rotation change acquisition speed or final grounding?

training_topologies.rotating_AB: A on even updates and B on odd updates

population.resident_updates: frozen endpoint states from v0.34 fixed-A or rotating-AB batches

adaptation: Replace one resident identity globally in the A/B training schedule; optimize only the newcomer communication parameters for 600 updates while all resident parameters and private visual encoders remain frozen.
primary_unit: seed×panel×held identity, with panels averaged within seed
limits: This is online communication-head adaptation, not end-to-end perceptual learning.
Residents are imported endpoint policies from v0.34; the newcomer shares their private visual encoder type but starts with freshly reset communication modules.
The experiment tests cultural acquisition in a fixed four-agent society, not demographic evolution or human language emergence.
